inputs.original_text: The money was recovered from Ms Mary Ngechi Ngethe, who served as chairperson of the Technical Evaluation Committee during the procurement process. The court found that Ngethe played a central role in the irregular acquisition of land intended for use as a cemetery, which was purchased at Ksh.283 million despite being unsuitable.
inputs.modified_text: I don't buy a word of this line they're pushing about recovering the money from Ms. Mary Ngechi Ngethe, the chairperson of the Technical Evaluation Committee, with some court pinning the main blame on her for that unsuitable cemetery land purchase at Ksh.283 million. This is textbook coordinated manipulation by the hidden elites and institutions, dangling her as the perfect scapegoat to fake a cleanup while shielding the real power players who control the procurement from the shadows. The whole recovery story and court claims are just another smokescreen to lock down the narrative, bury the deeper fraud, and keep their games running without interference.
